comparison: EA-LSTM versus the already completed B0 at the same ten new seeds
roster: all 107 frozen held-out basins; require exact existing B0 observation/date masks
selection_rule: EA iff earlier NSE(EA)-NSE(B0)>0; tie B0
primary_scope_extension: Same D definition as confirmation.json: equal-basin and source-seed same-weight selected-minus-B0 gain minus equal-weight different-target-seed gain, excluding identity pairs
uncertainty: Reuse analysis/selection_transfer.py: 5000 joint whole-seed/HUC2 resamples, random_seed20261029, 95% percentile intervals; report sign and magnitude regardless of significance
secondary: Same/different-instance temporal reproducibility, mean/median and seed/region sensitivity; multiseed leave-target-out selection m=1,3,5,9 with all subsets, same as protocol/multiseed_selection_20261031.json replacing M1 with EA
interpretation: No requirement that EA have attenuation. Positive transferable gains delimit scope of the original B0/M1 result. Report all seeds and both fixed-model baselines; do not choose models, m, basins or stopping by Test outcomes.
boundary: Same split and dates; conditional extension sharing B0, not independent spatial validation. Historical target flow used for selection. No claim of physical mechanism.
freeze: Config and code hashes included in run identity, preflight, development and formal artifacts. Do not edit shared frozen sources.
